description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Initial Confidence and Accuracy, comparing Final Accuracy, $\Delta$ Accuracy, and Initial Accuracy. The x-axis is labeled "Initial Confidence" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.81 to 0.99, with tick marks generally spaced at intervals of 0.01, though the value 0.83 is omitted. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 and tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The "Final Accuracy" is represented by a solid blue line with circle markers and error bars. It starts at a value of 1.0 at an initial confidence of 0.81 and ends at approximately 0.98 at 0.99, remaining relatively steady and high across the x-axis with minor fluctuations, reaching its lowest point of approximately 0.87 at an initial confidence of 0.95. The "$\Delta$ Accuracy" is depicted by a dashed orange line with diamond markers and error bars. It begins at approximately 0.46 at 0.81 and exhibits a general downward trend with several fluctuations, ending at its lowest point of approximately 0.04 at 0.99, with notable dips occurring at 0.86 (approximately 0.14), 0.89 (approximately 0.15), and 0.95 (approximately 0.14). Finally, the "Initial Accuracy" is shown as a dash-dot green line with square markers and error bars. It starts at approximately 0.54 at 0.81 and shows an overall upward trend with fluctuations, concluding at its highest point of approximately 0.94 at 0.99. This line experiences a notable peak of approximately 0.76 at 0.86, followed by a decline to approximately 0.58 at 0.88, and another dip to approximately 0.65 at 0.91 before climbing towards the end of the axis.
